@ImYourDustiny44 Hi Dustin, the Send to Self transaction is when you send Doge from your wallet to an address in your wallet as well. The value of that transaction is zero because you're not moving any Dogecoin in or out of your wallet.
What error are you getting when exchanging?

@xtzfaucet Hi. When sending transactions, if you're not sending (spending) the entire amount, some of it may return into what is called a change address, but that's part of your wallet as well. You can see all your addresses in the MENU > Tools < View Private Keys > Dogecoin.

@Cryptoc06883871 Hi. Paste in the address as well to see the final fee amount.
Those may actually be correct if you have a lot of incoming transactions (UTXOs) that make up the maximum balance. Transaction mining fees on the Dogecoin blockchain are calculated based on the actual size, not amount.
